title: New Africa Roll Call
script: New Africa roll call! Where my people dey? From Lagos to London! Accra to Atlanta! Nairobi to New York! Johannesburg to Joburg! Addis to anywhere! Kigali to Kingston! New Africa no get border – we dey everywhere! Drop your flag in the comments, make we count how many countries we don reach. This na our moment – from the continent to the diaspora, we dey move together!
caption:
🌍 NEW AFRICA ROLL CALL! 📢

From Lagos to London, Accra to Atlanta, Nairobi to New York – WHERE MY PEOPLE DEY?

👇🏾 DROP YOUR CITY/COUNTRY FLAG BELOW!

Let's see how FAR we've reached!
Continent + Diaspora = ONE COMMUNITY 💛💚
